name: redirect-uri-input
title: Redirect URI Input
description: Prevents redirect_uri_mismatch sign-in failures and leaked authorization codes by checking a redirect URI the way an OAuth server does, exact string match, so it catches a trailing slash, http versus https, letter case, www or a port that differs from the registered list (with the differing characters highlighted side by side and a one-tap swap), plus localhost in production, wildcards, a default :443 port or empty ?, a #fragment, stray whitespace and short custom schemes.
